none: PAS SUSS-E401D7: Roman Coin: Silver-Plated Copper-alloy Contemporary Copy of Denarius of Vespasian
contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver-plated contemporary copy of a Roman denarius of Vespasian (AD 69-79), probably dating from AD 72-73 (Reece period 4). Prototype of Rome. TRI-POT reverse type depicting Vesta seated left, holding simpulum. Mint of Rome. Although no exact parallel is known, it is likely that this coin was meant to imitate those similar to a known type with a slightly different legend: cf: RIC II, p. 19-20,…
